payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped self-built P2P WebRTC media path: P2PWebRTCAdapter (coturn-REST ephemeral TURN creds, STUN-only fallback, p2p/max2 caps, idempotent allocate) + startP2PCall perfect-negotiation driver over the existing WebRTCSignal relay, browser-agnostic via injectable RTCPeerConnectionLike. Gate green: typecheck 0, core 59, server 1027 (+7).
